title: VIXEN kernel pin cannot move past b1576418a without a consumer namespace migration (da6079b05)
body: Every landed kernel main after b1576418a (d1 70dba0331, d2 c28f5ee45, d3 10ec46339) carries da6079b05 'derive kernel native namespaces': generated C++ types/callables land in their declared C# namespace, --recipe-simd-cpp needs --namespace/--include, --recipe-parameter-block writes per-type dirs, --callable-cpp emits one namespace per invocation, and a [View] projection whose callable is outside the --schema dir emits '<global namespace>::bitAt' (kernel should fail closed). On VIXEN, bumping the pin turns 24 *_check drift guards red and, once regenerated, 'all' stops compiling (SdfBake.h, SdfRecipeEval.h, GlyphOutline.h, GlyphAtlas.h, RecipeRegistry.h, *ConfigNode TUs). This keeps frame_targets_schema_check (T-4659, WithInputGrammar) red on every VIXEN lane. Partial migration (CLI flags, callables split with a re-export shim, recipe-block dirs) is in /home/liory/codeman-cases/undertow/reports/op-vixtrain6-evidence/pinbump-partial-migration/. Extends 5eb30ea4fc5b. Tier sol: cross-repo namespace migration over many consumers plus a kernel fail-closed fix.

title: Detached VIXEN queue jobs disappear unless the lane adds setsid
body: The documented detached command nohup bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent op-vixtrain6 --resource build ... produced an empty log and no surviving process. Repeating the same queued invocation as nohup setsid bash ... worked. The queue/background launcher should establish the durable session itself or document one canonical wrapper. Tier haiku: one launcher/session-boundary fix; exact workaround was adding setsid.

title: VIXEN build-time CMake regeneration loses the required Undertow root
body: Queued cmake --build build/wsl --target sdf_core_kernels_regen triggered cmake --regenerate-during-build after the tracked pin changed and failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent, even though the build tree had been configured with that root. The working recovery was a separate queued cmake --preset vixen-wsl with UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/vixtrain6 and VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE set, followed by the target build. Persist the resolved root in the build contract so automatic regeneration is self-contained. Tier haiku: a cache/launcher propagation fix.
